title: Dangermond Preserve — Inferred Creek Water Surface Elevations, hourly values WY2023 (CSV)
snippet: Every hourly inferred water surface elevation for every creek stretch in the Dangermond Preserve, WY2023, as a zipped CSV.
description:
Every hourly inferred water surface elevation (WSE) for every short creek stretch in the Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve, water year WY2023 (October 2022 – January 2023, a partial year), as a zipped CSV file. Columns: segment_id, tnc_comid, time_utc, wse_m (meters above NAVD88), junction_wse_upstream_m, junction_wse_downstream_m.

Companion download for the inferred creek water surface elevation layer; see that item for how the values were made and their accuracy limits. Estimates, not measurements. Produced by the UCSB Spatial Center for the Dangermond Preserve Digital Twin.
accessInformation: NOAA National Water Model v3.0 retrospective; California Natural Flows Database; USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1 m terrain; TNC (The Nature Conservancy) flowlines; EPA NHDPlusV2. Derived by the UCSB Spatial Center.
